comments.text: Who else felt that chill down their spine when they talked about winter isolation in mountain villages? That cold is no joke.

replies.author: @TheGlobalTruth04
replies.text: I know what you mean! 🥶 It really shows how resilient the people in those mountain communities are. Thanks for sharing! ❤️

comments.author: @globerealife
comments.text: Having over a million men leave for work abroad while the women stay behind to run entire households and communities on their own is a staggering dynamic. How can a nation build a sustainable domestic economy when its greatest resource—its workforce—is constantly forced to seek survival elsewhere?

replies.author: @TheGlobalTruth04
replies.text: That’s a powerful question. A sustainable economy depends on creating enough secure, well-paid opportunities at home so migration becomes a choice rather than a necessity. Thank you for raising such an important point. 🙏

comments.author: @TheDistantLens_Us
comments.text: What impressed me most is the resilience of the people. Despite incredibly difficult conditions, they continue to build their lives and support their communities.
